candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method afterRender to class FormFragment
candidates.description:
Move method afterRender to org.apache.tapestry5.corelib.components.FormFragment
Rationale: The method 'afterRender' is closely related to the rendering process of a form fragment, as it deals with closing the <div> tag and managing the environmental state of FormSupport. Since FormFragment is responsible for rendering portions of a form, it is logical to move this method there to maintain cohesion. The method manipulates attributes of the hidden field positioner, which is a property of FormFragment, and it also interacts with the environment stack, which is managed within the FormFragment context.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method newAttributeElement2 to class PageElementFactoryImpl
candidates.description:
Move method newAttributeElement2 to org.apache.tapestry5.internal.services.PageElementFactoryImpl
Rationale: The method newAttributeElement2() is primarily concerned with creating a RenderCommand that involves parsing an attribute expansion expression and rendering an attribute with a namespace and name. This functionality is closely related to the responsibilities of the PageElementFactoryImpl class, which already has a method for parsing attribute expressions (parseAttributeExpansionExpression). Moving this method to PageElementFactoryImpl would enhance cohesion by keeping related functionalities together, as it deals with the creation of elements and their attributes.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method fireValidateFormEvent to class Form
candidates.description:
Move method fireValidateFormEvent to org.apache.tapestry5.corelib.components.Form
Rationale: The method fireValidateFormEvent() is primarily concerned with triggering a validation event for a form and handling validation exceptions. Since the method directly interacts with the Form's resources to trigger the VALIDATE_FORM event and records errors on the form itself, it logically belongs within the Form class. Moving it there enhances cohesion, as it centralizes form-related event handling and validation logic, making the Form class more responsible for its own validation process.

candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method queueOverrideTokensForExtensionPoint to class PageLoaderImpl

Rationale: The method queueOverrideTokensForExtensionPoint() is responsible for managing the queuing of template tokens based on extension points, which is a core functionality of the page loading process. Since PageLoaderImpl is already handling the assembly and loading of components and their templates, it is logical to move this method there. This method interacts with the ComponentTemplate and TemplateToken classes, which are integral to the page loading and rendering process. By moving it to PageLoaderImpl, we can encapsulate all related logic for managing templates and their overrides in one place, improving cohesion and maintainability.
